data.one_liner: Flutter client for PostHog analytics, feature flags, and session replay
data.what_it_does: Sends events, identifies users, tracks sessions, and supports feature flags and session replay across iOS, Android, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_when: You need analytics and feature flag support in a Flutter app
You want session replay for debugging
You target multiple platforms including desktop
avoid_when: You only need simple logging or a lightweight analytics SDK
You are building a web‑only app and prefer a pure web solution
strengths: Session replay and crash capture on mobile
Easy to set up with a single setup call
weaknesses: Desktop support is experimental and limited to core analytics
No push notification or survey support on desktop
Requires native platform setup for path_provider
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, call `Posthog().setup(config)` in main, optionally set `config.enableWindowsAndLinux = false` for desktop disable.
